doom_description: Try to survive the original 3 episodes of the phenomenon USA Today called "...the most gripping computer game to date." You're a space Marine armed with a mere pistol. Your mission is to locate more substantial firepower, then blast your way through 27 level of the most explosive, demon-laden action ever!

win95_description: Windows 95 is a consumer-oriented operating system developed by Microsoft, released to manufacturing on July 14, 1995, and to retail on August 24, 1995. The first of the Windows 9x line of operating systems, Windows 95, which replaced Windows 3.1
